Plot data-quality profiles

Source: R/quality.R
plot.bdhs_quality.Rd

Draws the single-year age distribution of the household population (ages ending in 0 or 5 highlighted) or the number of births by calendar year (with the first year of the five-year window marked) from bdhs_quality() results.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bdhs_quality'
plot(x, type = c("age", "births"), ...)

# S3 method for class 'bdhs_quality'
autoplot(object, type = c("age", "births"), ...)

Arguments

x, object

A bdhs_quality result.

type

"age" (default) or "births".

...

Unused.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

q <- bdhs_quality(bdhs_simulate(2022, "PR"), checks = "age_heaping")
plot(q)
